candidats.titre: File:Mid 20th century Romuender try square Carl Fritz Romuender Remscheid Germany.jpg
candidats.description: Mid-20th-century Romünder try square, probably made by Carl Fritz Romünder in Remscheid, Germany. The square is marked “ROMÜNDER” and has a graduated steel blade and a metal stock with a knurled grip surface. Carl Fritz Romünder e. K. was a tool business in Remscheid, Germany, established in 1921. The exact manufacturer and production date of this example have not been confirmed. The square measures approximately 25 × 13.5 × 1.35 cm and weighs approximately 160 g.
